**I. Planning & Initial Response (Before Writing)**

1.  **Start with the Research Records:** This is absolutely critical. Before *anything* else, go back to your raw data, codebooks, experimental manipulations, and any notes taken during data collection.  You need the foundation to verify your findings and understand *why* the results differ from your prediction.  Don't rely on memory.
